Name: Snip's Cuter Kids - Vincent Jas and Leo Portraits
Author: ParcySnippet
Description:
[center][color=#fff2cc][size=6][b]❤︎ Features ❤︎[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[quote][i][b][size=4]❤︎[/size][size=3] [/size][/b][size=3]Cuter Kids overhauls all three vanilla kids' default and winter portraits! You can also disable any of the portraits using the Generic Mod Config Menu, which means you could mix and match them with their vanilla portraits or other individual portrait mods.[/size]

[b][size=4]❤︎[/size][/b][b][size=3] [/size][/b][b][size=3]Regarding any future updates:[/size][/b] [size=3]I probably will put out some small improvement tweaks in the future, but I can't promise new content soon or that a major update will happen, because these things take me a lot of effort to do. It's possible, but I wouldn't count on it. You're still free to leave suggestions on things you'd like added to their portraits though.[/size][/i][/quote][left][color=#fff2cc][size=3][b]And if you like this mod[/b], you may also enjoy this one I made which adds a cute little [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42877]Snowman NPC![/url][/size][/color][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=3][color=#fff2cc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42877][/url][/color][color=#cccccc]Regarding permissions:[/color][/size][/left]
[color=#cccccc][size=3]Please don’t use my portraits on other mods' thumbnails or publicly post edits of the art. Thank you![/size][/color]

[color=#fff2cc][size=3][b]Special Thanks:[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#fff2cc][size=3]I'd also like to thank Nic, Dolphin and Selph for help with the code along with everyone who offered their input when I asked for feedback on the art! [/size][/color]
